_comment: Glyph label -> plaintext. Letters are single characters; word-signs are in square brackets. grade: S determined by cryptanalysis (see README, permutation z), M uncertain, I inferred. 'from' names the words that fix the value.

A.from: remane, na mair, haill, thair, Carlyle

o.from: freindis, oure, remane, greit, thair, lord

Z2.from: to, of; L4.5 identification with this glyph is disputed in FRESH-MANUSCRIPT-REVIEW.md

Z5.from: Carlyle, haym; i also possible (Carlile, haim)

c.from: Carlyle; the second occurrence should be e and is read as a slip

g.from: suffering; single glyph for f or ff

U.from: the lord Fleming, gif the, spil the; stands alone at the start

4b.from: sign for a person or party after 'suffering of', presumably the Queen

Eb.from: sign for a person or party after 'gif the'; plausibly the Queen again

Zz.from: baseline t retained for reproducibility; eight-hit lattis argument withdrawn (six broken prelattis); k also possible; doubled in la??is and opens L4

t.from: haill e?; baseline t is unidentified; s (es = as) or a word-sign [as] are conjectures

x3.from: baseline e; fresh visual comparison favours n, still uncertain

Xs.from: line 4; fresh visual comparison favours u, still uncertain
